Currency, merchants, stock, buyback and repairs

A merchant issues an authoritative quote, then commits currency, inventory, stock and buyback/repair changes together. Store one integer base currency; copper/silver/gold display is a conversion, not three independently editable balances.

Scope and player interaction

A merchant issues an authoritative quote, then commits currency, inventory, stock and buyback/repair changes together. Store one integer base currency; copper/silver/gold display is a conversion, not three independently editable balances.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase11committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Closed → CatalogLoading → QuoteReady → PurchasePending → SalePending → BuybackPending → RepairPending → QuoteExpired

WBP_Merchant observes results from URPGMerchantComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Vendor_Mara. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
BaseCurrency bigint >=0; 100 copper=1 silver and 100 silver=1 gold display proposal
VendorId and OfferId: stable authored identifiers
QuoteId: bound to character/vendor/catalog version/price/quantity/expiry
StockState: optional finite quantity, restock generation and revision
BuybackEntryId: exact sold instance/stack, seller, paid price, expiry
RepairQuote: eligible owned item IDs, missing durability and total price
PriceModifiers: faction/reputation policy computed on authority

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGMerchantComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_MerchantLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
GetVendorQuote(VendorId, OfferId, Quantity) -> Quote|NotAvailable
Buy(CommandId, QuoteId) -> Purchased|InsufficientFunds|NoSpace|StaleQuote|OutOfStock
Sell(CommandId, VendorId, OwnedReference, Quantity) -> Sold|Bound|StaleItem
BuyBack(CommandId, BuybackEntryId) -> Restored|Expired|NoSpace|InsufficientFunds
Repair(CommandId, RepairQuoteId) -> Repaired|StaleQuote|InsufficientFunds

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Player talks to NPC_Mara; interaction server checks range/LOS and returns a vendor context and versioned offers.
  2. Buy UI requests a quote for a bounded quantity. Backend/zone price rules include catalog, stock and approved reputation modifiers; client displayed total is not authority.
  3. On confirm, lock wallet/inventory/vendor-stock/quote rows in a consistent order, repeat eligibility and capacity checks, and either apply all deltas or reject all.
  4. Selling transfers the exact item/quantity out and creates a seller-scoped buyback entry in the same transaction that credits currency; do not reroll or recreate the sold gear.
  5. Buyback consumes that entry and returns the same gear UUID, charging the stored price under the policy. Repairs update specific owned durability values and wallet together.
  6. Restock uses server time and a durable generation so restart cannot multiply stock. Results update UMG from committed revisions; stale quotes are refreshed explicitly.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create DA_Vendor_Mara with healing draught, starter tools, cloth and recipe offers; set one draught offer stock=1 in the contention fixture.
  2. Create BP_NPC_Mara with NPC definition plus vendor ID; it forwards requests and never stores Character_A's wallet.
  3. Build WBP_Merchant tabs Buy, Sell, Buyback and Repair, with quantity input, price breakdown, capacity warning and pending buttons.
  4. Seed Character_A with 1000 base currency and Character_B with 1000, draught unit price=50 for the fixture. Configure a quote expiry and stock restock rule.
  5. Reopen inventory/ledger/reputation consumers; use the same item identity/capacity planner for buy, sell, buyback and repair. Add a bank NPC separately but reuse interaction ownership.

Reopen Phase11 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / NPC_Mara / Offer_Draught / Buyback_A. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Two clients buy last stock -> one Purchased, one OutOfStock; only winner pays.
Insufficient funds or space -> unchanged wallet, inventory and stock.
Price changes after quote -> StaleQuote under strict quote-version policy; ask player to reconfirm.
Sell request uses replaced UUID -> StaleItem; no wrong gear sold.
Buyback after disconnect -> same original instance restored once; expired entry cannot be recovered by old UI.
Repair replay -> original receipt, no second currency charge.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Fixture prices are not a balanced economy. Proposed buyback window 2 hours, max 12 entries, quote lifetime 30 seconds. Finite stock is optional per offer; restock is not based on client clock.

Track currency sources/sinks, stock contention, buyback expiry and repair spend by content version. Use int64-safe arithmetic and upper bounds; reject overflow before multiplication.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
